[order-service#Data]
OrderService: Data
OrderService stores orders in the orders Postgres database. Line items are stored with the order and are immutable once the order is placed.

[billing-service#Integrations]
BillingService: Integrations
It depends on OrderService for line items. It calls the NotificationsAPI to send receipts once a capture succeeds.

The billing-service team also maintains the shared invoice templates.

[search-service#Integrations]
SearchService: Integrations
It depends on OrderService and reads order changes from it every minute.

part.text:
**Five services are affected within two hops of OrderService.** Counting OrderService and its exposed OrdersAPI as one hop location:

| Hop | Affected service | Dependency path |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **BillingService** | Depends on **OrderService** for line items. |
| 1 | **ReportingService** | Depends on **OrderService**. |
| 1 | **SearchService** | Depends on **OrderService** and reads its order changes every minute. |
| 1 | **ApiGateway** | Calls **OrdersAPI**, exposed by **OrderService**. |
| 2 | **RenewalsWorker** | Depends on **BillingService**, which depends on **OrderService**. |

These are the downstream services in scope for reviewing a line-item format change; actual code changes depend on how each consumes the data. No database or configuration key is part of these downstream dependency paths.
